c74object.name: bachmcp.bpatcher.generator
c74object.digest: Generator and panel, for a bpatcher
c74object.description: The view of bachmcp.generator: load it in a bpatcher with the instance's name in @args. Scores come in and go out as lllls, so it connects directly to a bach.roll.

outlet.digest: To bach.roll: the score as a llll

objarg.name: name
objarg.description: The name the model and the server know this instance by. Unique across open patches.
